SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND cs.store_id <> 999 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
